Checked bounded rendered page text for required shift-meter terminology and forbidden raw opening/closing proof phrases.

Logged out, logged in with the reusable supervisor QA credential, opened /supervisor/dashboard, waited for floor data loading to finish, and checked the rendered production logging copy.
Captured screenshots and console warning/error checks for the exercised surfaces.
